'''Red 32's Star Wars CCG decks''' are constructed lists published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] (cmikehardy.tripod.com) by [[Carl Mike Hardy]] and visitors. The live Tripod URL is dead; the working copy is the Wayback snapshot of 13 May 2021.

Visitor 60s keep the published title, the author as posted, the card list, and a [[GEMP importable decklist|GEMP Importable deck]] download when the published list has 60 cards. Training decks are Common/Uncommon teaching lists. The index also pointed at the official [[Death Star II Starter Decks]] as a teaching reference.

A parent index of all published 60s is [[Decklists]].
